title: PWOL drawdown controls on a frozen 64-path synthetic batch
author: Pengyi Peng
calibration: NONE; first 16 consecutive seeds per fixed offset; no filtering, fitting or retries based on results.
benchmark: Same synthetic four assets, equal initial buy and hold, no charges; one matched benchmark per seed reused for all variants and profiles.
costs: Both sides pay commission plus slippage = base bps + min(gap cap bps, gap bps per pct times 100*abs(asset close-to-open return)). Sizing uses the simulated open only, after the target is decided; costs debit cash at the mark, and future intraday moves never set slippage. This is not an order book model.

gate.short_rule: Tiered MDD improvement vs original is positive and at least 80% of any positive binary improvement. Tiered compounded return across all fixed rebound legs is strictly higher than binary.
gate.full_rule: Primary joint requires the short rule plus tiered full-period net return no worse than binary. Research promotion requires at least 50% full-joint in every family and no worse batch worst MDD than binary, at both cost profiles. Not deployment authorization.

windows: Segments fixed before any simulation; apply deterministic common jitter. Rebound score compounds returns across only declared rebound legs (no intervening sessions); always report continuous full-period NAV independently. Asset contribution is reported per leg and full period, not summed across overlapping bases.
